name: Chronicle 2.0
tagline: AI-powered presentation builder that skips the generic filler and actually looks good.
problem: Most AI presentation tools produce bloated, generic slides that require heavy editing before they're usable. Chronicle 2.0 targets professionals who need polished, on-brand decks fast without the usual AI-generated mediocrity. It aims to close the gap between AI speed and human-quality output.
useCases: Building investor pitch decks without starting from scratch
Creating client-facing sales presentations with consistent branding
Producing internal strategy or roadmap decks quickly
Turning reports or documents into structured slide narratives
